body.x: 10kM.ai Co., Ltd. (CEO Yuseok Elton Kim) participated in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition, held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9 (local time).

10kM.ai is a Korean startup that has researched and developed technologies to reduce the time and cost burden associated with video production. The company has commercialized an AI-based service that creates high-quality video content using only a small number of images, thereby lowering barriers to entry for content creation and serving a wide range of users, from individual creators to corporate teams, according to the company.

10kM.ai focuses on replacing repetitive, labor-intensive video production processes with automation. It implemented a solution that applies AI across the entire production process, from planning and scriptwriting to shot composition, subtitle generation, and final editing, thereby maximizing production efficiency.

Based on these technologies, 10kM.ai has collaborated with various domestic companies to conduct technical verification and phased service expansion, and through its participation in CES 2026, it sought opportunities for global collaboration. At the exhibition, the company highlighted its core product, “GEMGEM.SG,” a solution in which users upload one to four photos, and AI analyzes the images' context to construct a story and generate video content with natural cuts, subtitles, and voice.

GEMGEM.SG is designed to quickly produce content frequently used in corporate communication and marketing, such as brand promotion videos, product introductions, corporate messages, and event announcements. It has drawn attention as an innovative alternative that maximizes production speed and cost efficiency for small businesses and marketing teams burdened by repetitive video production processes.

In practice, 10kM.ai is known to conduct proofs of concept and pilot operations primarily with small- and mid-sized enterprises, content production companies, and brand marketing organizations in the Korean market. In addition, the company has validated the effectiveness of its service by carrying out marketing and communication projects using AI video automation technologies with companies in telecommunications, insurance, retail, and content industries.

At the CES exhibition site, 10kM.ai directly demonstrated the photo-based video generation process, emphasizing the intuitiveness and scalability of GEMGEM.SG through results completed in a short time. A 10kM.ai official said, “Participation in CES 2026 was the first stage to fully introduce GEMGEM.SG’s AI video auto-generation technology to the global market,” adding, “We focused on intuitive demos so that multinational buyers and partners could directly experience and grasp our technology.”

The official continued, “While we are currently concentrating on service validation in the domestic market, we plan to pursue phased overseas expansion targeting the United States, Japan, and Southeast Asia, where demand for mobile short-form content is growing rapidly.” The official added, “Going forward, we will advance B2C services while expanding B2B SaaS, and through industry-specific templates and country-level localization, we aim to grow into a global AI video production platform.”

The Incheon Metropolitan City Government and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority formed the “INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion” at LVCC North Hall during CES 2026, presenting Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as it evolves beyond a smart city into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs, including Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Awards Showcase, the pavilion supported the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES, including 10 companies exhibiting at the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion. In particular, 14 companies won 17 CES Innovation Awards, marking the largest achievement to date and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovative enterprises.
